label: SFP 1000BASE-ZX 80 km
notes: IEEE 802.3 does not define 1000BASE-ZX: "ZX" is a vendor convention for a 1550 nm extended-reach 1G optic, so this row cites the convention as a vendor publishes it (Cisco 1000BASE-ZX: 1500-1580 nm, launch 0..+5 dBm, receive -3..-23 dBm, 21 dB channel budget, about 70 km on single-mode fibre). The -24 dBm sensitivity and 80 km here are typical of third-party ZX-compatible modules rather than of that datasheet. Vendor-defined class, not a standard one: replace these figures with the module you buy.
